hypotheses.N0_natural_rank16_is_sufficient: The rank-16 PCA basis learned only from unedited FineWeb states reaches fidelity at least 0.70 and lies within 0.15 of the pooled rank-32 oracle on every corpus.
hypotheses.N1_target_conditioning_is_unnecessary: At rank 16, natural-state PCA is within 0.05 fidelity of newline-paired-state PCA on every corpus.
hypotheses.N2_natural_basis_replicates_across_slice: Independent natural-state rank-16 bases differ by at most 0.05 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.N3_natural_basis_beats_random: At ranks 8, 16, and 32, both natural bases beat matched random-subspace fidelity by at least 0.20 on every corpus.
hypotheses.N4_natural_basis_is_geometrically_stable: The two natural rank-16 subspaces have mean squared canonical cosine at least 0.80.
hypotheses.N5_behavioral_compression_exceeds_state_: For some corpus, rank-16 causal fidelity exceeds the fraction of changed-state energy captured by at least 0.20.
